result.title: D3Tree: Learning to Prune Block-Diffusion Draft Trees for Efficient Verification
result.summary: Block-diffusion drafters propose a whole block of tokens in one forward pass, and draft trees built from their position-wise marginals increase the expected accepted length of speculative decoding. Every tree node occupies a query row in target verification, so under concurrent serving low-yield branches compete with other requests for verification capacity. Existing tree methods select verified nodes by draft probability under a fixed or cost-selected per-request budget, and thus always retain a prefix of the drafter's ranking. We present D3Tree, which learns which nodes of a block-diffusion draft tree are worth verifying. A tree-size head with 2H+2 parameters predicts each candidate's conditional survival from the draft state, the candidate embedding, and its draft log-probability. Thresholding the product of these scores along parent chains yields an ancestor-closed subtree whose size adapts to each request and decoding round. The head is trained on a frozen drafter with conditional labels on the full candidate tree; an optional joint mode also steers the drafter toward the retained reference path. At serving time, D3Tree verifies whole trees under light load and, under heavy load, allocates one batch-wide node budget by predicted survival, sized to the target's matrix-multiplication tiles. Retained trees share one ancestor-masked target pass, while construction, pruning, and scheduling run on the GPU and overlap with the host. Across six vision-language verifiers and 17 text and multimodal benchmarks, D3Tree is fastest in 70 of 72 load settings, with 3.2-4.0x speedup over autoregressive decoding for one request and 1.3-1.8x at 64 concurrent requests, where fixed-budget trees fall below autoregressive speed. Under a time-varying arrival trace, it has the lowest mean end-to-end latency in every arrival phase.

AI.brief_summary: D3Tree 用仅 2H+2 参数的轻量 head 从 draft 状态、候选嵌入与 draft log-prob 预测 block-diffusion 草稿树各节点的条件存活率，沿父链阈值化得到祖先闭包子树，并在负载高时按预测存活率分配批级节点预算；在冻结 drafter 上训练，跨多种视觉语言 verifier 与多模态基准测试加速效果。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「学习候选分支存活并据此裁剪、按预算决定验证多少」的机制，可能为 latent 多假设的筛选与验证计算分配提供线索，但论文目标是解码加速而非视觉推理状态，需核查能否迁移到 LVR 的假设选择与停止决策。
